requirement_text: Maintain ICT asset inventory
notes: Require standard labels (owner, team, dora-article) on all resources. Enforces labelling but cannot verify completeness of the inventory itself.

requirement_text: Maintain documentation of ICT systems
notes: Require description annotation on all workloads. Enforces presence of documentation metadata, not content quality.

requirement_text: Identify and classify ICT assets by criticality
notes: Require criticality label (high/medium/low). Classification decision is human; enforcement of the label is automated.

requirement_text: Map ICT asset dependencies and interconnections
notes: Require upstream/downstream dependency annotations. Extends REQ-012 beyond labelling. Policy checks annotation presence, not accuracy.

requirement_text: Establish ICT risk assessment process
notes: Governance process requiring human risk assessment. Outside admission control scope entirely.

requirement_text: Identify and document all ICT assets supporting business functions
notes: Require structured metadata annotations (business-function, data-classification, owner). Art. 8 is identification, distinct from Art. 9 protection.
change_log: FIXED - corrected to identification scope; renamed from require-security-context

requirement_text: Ensure confidentiality of data at rest
notes: Deny PVCs referencing StorageClasses without encryption-at-rest configuration.

requirement_text: Ensure integrity and confidentiality of data in transit
notes: Enforce TLS on all Ingress resources and external-facing Services.

requirement_text: Ensure data integrity through immutable container images
notes: Block 'latest' tag; require digest (sha256:) or semantic version.

requirement_text: Implement network segmentation controls
notes: SPECIFIED BUT NOT IMPLEMENTED. Enforcing NetworkPolicy existence per namespace requires cross-resource lookup at admission time, which suffers the same deferred-enforcement problem documented for REQ-024. Recorded as a scope limitation rather than a claimed capability.
change_log: CHANGED v3 - was partially-automatable claiming require-network-policy/doranetworkpolicy; no such policy exists

requirement_text: Implement logical segregation of ICT assets
notes: Require ResourceQuota on every non-system namespace. Compute isolation, distinct from REQ-008 network segmentation.

requirement_text: Restrict container runtime privileges - non-root execution
notes: Enforce runAsNonRoot: true and drop ALL capabilities.

requirement_text: Prevent container breakout - host isolation
notes: Block privileged: true, hostPID, hostNetwork, hostIPC.

requirement_text: Enforce security hardening on container filesystems
notes: Enforce readOnlyRootFilesystem, seccomp profile, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false.
change_log: MOVED - was REQ-017 under Art. 8(1); reassigned to Art. 9(4)(a) as a protection control

requirement_text: Implement least-privilege access controls
notes: Block wildcard (*) resource permissions in RBAC rules.

requirement_text: Prevent privilege escalation through RBAC bindings
notes: Block direct cluster-admin ClusterRoleBindings to service accounts.

requirement_text: Implement authentication and session management controls
notes: Require session timeout annotations on Ingress. Policy enforces annotation presence; actual timeout logic depends on ingress controller configuration.

requirement_text: Restrict access to ICT resources to authorised service accounts only
notes: Block pods using the default ServiceAccount. Forces explicit SA assignment with RBAC.

requirement_text: Implement cryptographic key management controls
notes: Require SealedSecret or external-secrets-operator instead of plain Secrets. Key rotation policy remains organisational.

requirement_text: Enable kernel-level security auditing on containers
notes: Require seccomp profile and AppArmor annotation. Infrastructure-layer detection, distinct from REQ-020 app-level logging.
change_log: REFINED - sharpened from generic audit logging

requirement_text: Implement application-level log collection and forwarding
notes: Verify logging agent present via annotation or sidecar. Application-layer observability, distinct from REQ-005.

requirement_text: Ensure ICT system resilience through resource governance
notes: Enforce CPU/memory requests AND limits on all containers.

requirement_text: Ensure high availability of critical ICT services
notes: Enforce replicas >= 2 for criticality 'high'. NOTE: validated at admission only, not on the deployments/scale subresource.

requirement_text: Implement graceful degradation capabilities
notes: Require PDB annotation for criticality high/medium. Annotation presence is enforceable; PDB object existence is not verified at admission.

requirement_text: Test ICT resilience through scenario-based testing
notes: Chaos engineering and resilience testing are organisational processes. Cannot be enforced via admission control.

requirement_text: Establish backup and restoration procedures
notes: Backup strategy, retention and restoration testing are organisational processes.

requirement_text: Implement ICT change management processes
notes: Require change-id and approved-by annotations. Enforces traceability but cannot verify approval workflows.

requirement_text: Establish crisis communication plans and designate a communication lead for ICT-related incidents
notes: Art. 14 requires crisis communication plans enabling responsible disclosure of major ICT-related incidents or vulnerabilities to clients, counterparts and the public (14(1)); communication policies for internal staff and external stakeholders (14(2)); and at least one person tasked with implementing the communication strategy and fulfilling the public and media function (14(3)). All three are organisational obligations discharged by people and documented procedures. No Kubernetes resource field corresponds to any part of the article, so no admission policy can evidence conformance.
change_log: NEW v5 - Art. 14 yields no technically enforceable requirement and was omitted from v1-v4, leaving the register covering 10 of the 11 articles in the stated scope (Articles 5-15). Recorded explicitly so article coverage matches the scope claim and the omission is a documented finding rather than a gap.

requirement_text: Verify container image provenance and integrity
notes: IMPLEMENTED AS ANNOTATION PROXY. Kyverno has native verifyImages (Cosign/Notary); Gatekeeper has no equivalent. Both implementations check dora.io/image-signature-verified, which asserts rather than verifies. Strongest expressiveness differentiator.
change_log: CHANGED v3 - was fully-automatable; downgraded to reflect the annotation-proxy implementation

requirement_text: Restrict container images to pre-approved registries
notes: Allow only pre-approved registries. Blocks images from unknown sources.
